items.html: For afterwards, when the GAR of Gadlut are completed entering, as mentioned, and it is found that there the Chokhma is potentially included in Chesed, but it will not be entirely until the Chokhma of the GAR of Gadlut enters; and then those four articles will be divided into two aspects, half for Chokhma and half for Chesed, as mentioned. But now the four articles are there together in Chesed. And behold, Chesed now serves in place of an actual brain in Chokhma. And the two lower articles of Netzach remain for the Netzach of ZA. And in this same manner in the three lines.
